source_title: Apple TV’s New Psychological Thriller Officially Releases This Week - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Apple TV has cemented itself as the home of great television, with acclaimed series like Ted Lasso, Silo, and Severance demonstrating the platform's appetite for compelling stories and interesting characters. After suspenseful TV shows like Slow Horses and Presumed Innocent also impressed critics, it should be no surprise that Apple TV is releasing another thriller series to keep fans occupied.
Premiering this week, Apple TV's next small-screen outing is Nocturne , which adapts the best-selling crime novels The Sandman and Lazarus by Lars Kepler, the pen name of Swedish writing duo Alexandra Coelho Ahndoril and Alexander Ahndoril. Their Joona Linna novels have sold millions of copies worldwide, giving Nocturne a popular story to draw from. In only two days, fans will finally be able to see the psychological thriller books come to life.
Nocturne's Plot Promises a Tense Psychological Battle
Premiering this week , Nocturne stars Liv Schreiber as Jonah Lynn, a former soldier now working as a homicide detective who leaves the dangerous streets of Philadelphia in the hopes of building a quieter life in a small Pennsylvanian town. His plans for a fresh start quickly fall apart when his community comes under threat from Jurek Walter, a "diabolically cunning" serial killer who could be orchestrating the murders while imprisoned. As his investigation intensifies, Jonah finds himself confronting a nightmare that threatens everything he's tried so hard to keep buried.
Lars Kepler has published 11 Joona Linna novels, including The Hypnotist, The Nightmare, The Fire Witness, The Sandman, Stalker, The Rabbit Hunter, Lazarus, The Mirror Man, The Spider, The Sleepwalker, and Medusa .
Things only get worse for Jonah when the frantic search for Jurek's last victim thrusts his surrogate daughter right into the serial killer's orbit. With Jonah then caught between his responsibilities as a detective and his instinct to protect his family, Nocturne is set to deliver a tense psychological battle between the men on either side of the law. Early critic reviews are already promising; Nocturne has so far earned an 88% score on Rotten Tomatoes, with CBR's Katie Doll praising the lead cast's "sublime" performances, and Screen Rant's Dani Kessel Odom describing the story as "pulse-racing," despite being somewhat predictable.
Nocturne's Full Release Schedule: When Every Episode Comes Out
Nocturne officially premieres on Apple TV on Friday, October 30, 2026; Apple hasn't yet confirmed an official release time, though some suspect that episodes might become available as early as Thursday, October 29 at 9 pm ET and 6 pm PT. The first season consists of 10 episodes, with Episodes 1 and 2 arriving together on its premiere date before the series moves to a weekly release schedule. New episodes will release on the platform every Friday until the season finale drops on December 25.
Alongside lead actors Liv Schreiber, Stephen Graham, and Zazie Beetz, Nocturne boasts a formidable ensemble cast that includes Bill Camp, Rory Culkin, Chrissy Metz, Poorna Jagannathan, and Gary Carr. Behind the scenes, Rowan Joffé ( Before I Go to Sleep and Tin Star ) serves as creator, while John Hlavin developed Nocturne and serves as showrunner. Acclaimed director Tim Van Patten, whose credits include Black Mirror and The Sopranos , directed the first two episodes.
With its combination of best-selling thriller source material , stellar cast, and darkly gripping story, Nocturne has plenty to offer psychological thriller fans. Apple TV subscribers don't have to wait long to find out whether Jonah can uncover the truth before the danger closes in on him, with Episodes 1 and 2 officially releasing on Friday, 30 October.
